title: Visual Schedule
goal: Increase independence and reduce anxiety during transitions.
tip: Start with morning routines; keep it consistent for 2 weeks.

title: First–Then Board
goal: Help children complete a non-preferred task before a preferred one.
tip: Keep 'First' very short at the beginning.

title: Token Reinforcement
goal: Build motivation through small earned rewards.
tip: Use immediate praise with each token.

title: Calm Corner Setup
goal: Provide a safe space to practice calming skills.
tip: It's not a punishment space—teach it proactively.

title: Emotion Labeling
goal: Improve emotional vocabulary and reduce escalations.

title: Choice Making
goal: Reduce power struggles with controlled choices.
tip: Both options must be truly okay for you.

title: Transition Countdown
goal: Improve compliance and reduce surprise transitions.
tip: Pair warnings with a simple next-step instruction.

title: Positive Practice
goal: Teach the correct behavior by practicing it.
tip: Keep it short and calm—avoid lectures.

title: Behavior Specific Praise
goal: Increase desired behaviors through precise praise.
tip: Praise effort + strategy, not only results.

title: Premack Principle
goal: Use a high-probability behavior to reinforce a low-probability one.
tip: Use it for homework, hygiene, cleanup.

title: Functional Communication
goal: Replace challenging behavior with a communication skill.

title: Stop–Think–Do
goal: Teach impulse control and problem solving.

title: Task Chunking
goal: Reduce overwhelm by breaking tasks into small steps.
steps: Do one step at a time
tip: Use checklists and keep steps visible.

title: Coping Menu
goal: Provide a list of calming options a child can choose from.

title: Data Snapshot
goal: Track patterns to guide better interventions.
tip: Keep it simple—1 minute per entry.
